text: One row per concept, a standardized medical code. Concepts of all vocabularies are in this table.
Links between pairs of concepts, each with a relationship type.
The concept hierarchy: each concept with all concepts below it.
The classes a concept can have.
The domains a concept can belong to.
The vocabularies (coding systems) whose concepts are in concept_seed.
The relationship types used in concept_relationship_seed.
A custom mapping from codes of a source system to concepts, kept by the data owner.
Alternative names of concepts.
The strength of the ingredients of drug concepts.
Unique number of the concept. Other tables refer to a concept by this number.
Name of the concept.
The domain the concept belongs to, for example Condition, Drug or Measurement. A concept belongs to one domain. Refers to domain_seed.domain_id.
The coding system the concept comes from, for example SNOMED, RxNorm or LOINC. Refers to vocabulary_seed.vocabulary_id.
The class of the concept within its vocabulary. Refers to concept_class_seed.concept_class_id.
Whether the concept is a standard concept. S means standard, C means classification, empty means non-standard.
The code of the concept as written in its coding system. A code is unique only within one vocabulary; the same code can exist in several vocabularies.
First date on which the concept is valid.
Date after which the concept is no longer valid.
Why the concept stopped being valid: D means deprecated, U means replaced by another concept. NULL if the concept is still valid.
The concept the relationship starts from. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
The concept the relationship points to. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.

The type of the relationship from concept_id_1 to concept_id_2, for example Is a, Maps to or Mapped from. A Maps to row links concept_id_1 to the standard concept concept_id_2 that represents it. Refers to relationship_seed.relationship_id. A standard concept has a Maps to row that points to itself.
First date on which the relationship is valid.
Date after which the relationship is no longer valid.
Why the relationship stopped being valid: D means deprecated, U means replaced. NULL if still valid.
A concept higher in the hierarchy. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
A concept below the ancestor in the hierarchy. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
The smallest number of steps between ancestor and descendant.
The largest number of steps between ancestor and descendant.
Identifier of the concept class, as used in concept_seed.concept_class_id.
Name of the concept class.
The concept that represents the class itself. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
Identifier of the domain, as used in concept_seed.domain_id.
Name of the domain.
The concept that represents the domain itself. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
Identifier of the vocabulary, as used in concept_seed.vocabulary_id.
Name of the vocabulary.
Where the vocabulary comes from.
Version of the vocabulary.
The concept that represents the vocabulary itself. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
Identifier of the relationship type, as used in concept_relationship_seed.relationship_id.
Name of the relationship type.
Whether the relationship builds a hierarchy: 1 yes, 0 no.
Whether the relationship is used to build the concept hierarchy: 1 yes, 0 no.
The relationship type that describes the same link read from the other end.
The concept that represents the relationship type itself. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
The concept the synonym belongs to. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
An alternative name of the concept.
The concept that represents the language of the synonym.
The drug concept the strength belongs to. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
The ingredient concept the strength is given for. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
Amount of the ingredient in one unit of a drug given as an amount.
Unit of amount_value. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
Amount of the ingredient for a drug given as a concentration.
Unit of numerator_value. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
Volume or amount the numerator refers to.
Unit of denominator_value. Refers to concept_seed.concept_id.
Number of units in a box.
First date on which the strength record is valid.
Date after which the strength record is no longer valid.
Why the record stopped being valid: D deprecated, U replaced. Empty if still valid.
The code as written in the source system.
The concept for the source code.
The coding system of the source code.
Text description of the source code.
The concept the source code is mapped to.
The vocabulary of the target concept.
First date on which the concept is valid.
Date after which the concept is no longer valid.
Why the concept stopped being valid: D means deprecated, U means replaced by another concept. NULL if the concept is still valid.
The domain of the source concept.
The domain of the target concept.
Name of the target concept.
The class of the source concept.
The class of the target concept.
